answer_verbatim:
If you want to **check whether AI engines like ChatGPT recommend your small business**, the best fit is usually an **AI visibility / AEO monitoring tool**, not a general AI evaluation platform.[19][11]

For small businesses, the strongest options in the results are:

- **Semrush AI Visibility** — good if you want a recognizable SEO-style tool with prompt research, competitor research, and site audit features at a lower entry price.[19]
- **HubSpot AEO** — a practical choice if you already use HubSpot CRM and want recommendations tied to customer data.[19]
- **Cognizo** — better if you want broader automated monitoring across many engines and more hands-off tracking.[19]
- **Rankability** — useful if you specifically want recommendation-vs-mention tracking across multiple AI platforms.[19]

If you want the **best overall balance for a small business**, the results suggest **Semrush AI Visibility** is the safest first pick because it is comparatively affordable and built for this kind of visibility tracking.[19] If your main goal is simply to see whether ChatGPT mentions or recommends you, **Brand Performance**-style monitoring is also directly relevant because it tracks weekly AI responses across ChatGPT, Google AI, Gemini, and Perplexity.[19]

A useful rule from the results is: **first define the question** you want answered—brand mention, recommendation share, competitor comparison, or governance/risk—because different services are optimized for different outcomes.[2]
